registered: after FPA-1 (P5 passed), before any check below

checks.control: unconditional 30-minute opening-range breakout (no NR filter): does the NR7 condition add anything?
checks.placebo: NR7 days replaced by randomly drawn days at the same frequency (20 draws, seed 7): distribution of the judge Sharpe
checks.neighbourhood: NR4 / NR5 / NR6 / NR8 / NR10 with the 30-minute range; NR7 with 15 / 45 / 60-minute ranges
checks.book: P5 as an entrant of the futures book (scripts/fbook.judge; the sleeve is 0 before 2018) and as a stand-alone intraday book

judge: P5 is a candidate only if: NR7 beats the unconditional ORB on judge, the actual judge Sharpe is above the 90th percentile of the placebo draws, at least 6 of the 8 neighbours have judge >= 0.3, 2x costs keep judge >= 0.3. Otherwise it is recorded as a likely fluke
